title: gastrochilus obtusifolius
intro: Gastrochilus obtusifolius, commonly known as the yellow helmet orchid, is a species of orchid native to the Himalayas and Southeast Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, as well as its potential to lower cholesterol and blood sugar levels. The therapeutic actions of Gastrochilus obtusifolius include its ability to treat various conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its expectorant and bronchodilatory properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
